<BEGIN_SHACL>
@prefix nltl: <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#> .
@prefix sh: <http://www.w3.org/ns/shacl#> .
@prefix rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> .
@prefix rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .
@prefix dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/> .
@prefix qudt: <http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/> .
@prefix unit: <http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/> .

nltl:I2_004_UpperIceWaterlineDisplacementShape
    a sh:NodeShape ;
    sh:targetClass nltl:ship ;
    sh:property [
        a sh:PropertyShape ;
        sh:path nltl:upperIceWaterlineDisplacement ;
        sh:minCount 1 ;
        sh:maxCount 1 ;
        sh:node nltl:I2_004_QuantityValueShape ;
        sh:severity sh:Violation ;
        sh:message "Each admitted ship must have exactly one upper ice waterline displacement DUI, represented as a quantity in metric kilotonnes." ;
    ] ;
    sh:property [
        a sh:PropertyShape ;
        sh:path nltl:hasUpperIceWaterlineCase ;
        sh:minCount 1 ;
        sh:node nltl:I2_004_UpperIceWaterlineCaseShape ;
        sh:severity sh:Violation ;
        sh:message "Each admitted ship must have at least one upper ice waterline case." ;
    ] ;
    sh:sparql [
        a sh:SPARQLConstraint ;
        sh:select """
            SELECT $this
            WHERE {
                FILTER NOT EXISTS {
                    $this <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#type> ?admittedType .
                    ?admittedType <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#subClassOf>* <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#ship> .
                }
            }
        """ ;
        sh:message "The focus node is not typed as nltl:ship under the RDFS class hierarchy required by the caller-admitted population." ;
        sh:severity sh:Violation ;
    ] ;
    sh:sparql [
        a sh:SPARQLConstraint ;
        sh:select """
            SELECT $this
            WHERE {
                $this <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#upperIceWaterlineDisplacement> ?upperQuantity .
                ?upperQuantity <http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/numericValue> ?upperValue ;
                                <http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/unit> <http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/KiloTON_Metric> .

                FILTER (
                    EXISTS {
                        $this <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#hasUpperIceWaterlineCase> ?greaterCase .
                        ?greaterCase <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#waterlineCaseDisplacement> ?greaterQuantity .
                        ?greaterQuantity <http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/numericValue> ?greaterValue ;
                                        <http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/unit> <http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/KiloTON_Metric> .
                        FILTER (?greaterValue > ?upperValue)
                    }
                    ||
                    NOT EXISTS {
                        $this <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#hasUpperIceWaterlineCase> ?equalCase .
                        ?equalCase <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#waterlineCaseDisplacement> ?equalQuantity .
                        ?equalQuantity <http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/numericValue> ?equalValue ;
                                       <http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/unit> <http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/KiloTON_Metric> .
                        FILTER (?equalValue = ?upperValue)
                    }
                )
            }
        """ ;
        sh:message "The ship displacement DUI must equal the greatest displacement among the waterline cases used to determine the UIWL." ;
        sh:severity sh:Violation ;
    ] ;
    rdfs:label "I2-004 upper ice waterline displacement shape"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Represents IACS UR I2 clause I2.1.2.2: the ship displacement DUI is the displacement, in kt, corresponding to the upper ice waterline (UIWL). Where multiple waterlines are used for determining the UIWL, the displacement is to be determined from the waterline corresponding to the greatest displacement."@en ;
    rdfs:comment "The target is limited to the caller-admitted synthetic design population of nltl:ship records. External Polar Class eligibility, construction-date eligibility, and legally governing edition applicability are not independently inferred or enforced by this shape."@en ;
    rdfs:comment "The source applicability statement is retained: This UR applies to Polar Class ships according to UR I1. The referenced UR I1 context and edition are caller-supplied contextual evidence, not independently verified eligibility predicates."@en ;
    dcterms:source [
        rdfs:comment "file=data/requirements/IACS_I2_full.txt; document_sha256=7ad8d57459782b70809da479380584a57cf259c66d9ff286811c0248b02732d2; selection_start=0; selection_end=1304; selection_sha256=c6e77eb821ae603a13c191d7eb5073821d353775215f91d431bb454faf9207cb; section_ids=PREAMBLE,I2.1,I2.1.1,I2.1.2,I2.1.2.1,I2.1.2.2."@en
    ] ;
    dcterms:source [
        rdfs:comment "Source selection manifest sha256=36c8b4e14715ec0e62f77b4d278a08ee5776a42ff869d433d66a8afb2beef41d; included_characters=2448; original_characters=62501; omitted_sections=108. Missing necessary evidence remains unresolved."@en
    ] ;
    rdfs:comment "Unresolved source references retained for review: UR I1 (source offset 320-325); UR I1 section I1.1.6 (source offset 50772-50778); UR I2 section I2.13 (source offset 50843-50848). These references do not activate or deactivate this shape."@en .

nltl:I2_004_UpperIceWaterlineCaseShape
    a sh:NodeShape ;
    sh:class nltl:upperIceWaterlineCase ;
    sh:property [
        a sh:PropertyShape ;
        sh:path nltl:waterlineCaseDisplacement ;
        sh:minCount 1 ;
        sh:maxCount 1 ;
        sh:node nltl:I2_004_QuantityValueShape ;
        sh:severity sh:Violation ;
        sh:message "Each upper ice waterline case must have exactly one waterline-case displacement in metric kilotonnes." ;
    ] ;
    rdfs:label "I2-004 upper ice waterline case shape"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "The case represents a waterline used for determining the UIWL. Multiple cases are permitted; the greatest valid case displacement determines DUI."@en .

nltl:I2_004_QuantityValueShape
    a sh:NodeShape ;
    sh:class qudt:QuantityValue ;
    sh:property [
        a sh:PropertyShape ;
        sh:path qudt:numericValue ;
        sh:minCount 1 ;
        sh:maxCount 1 ;
        sh:datatype xsd:decimal ;
        sh:severity sh:Violation ;
        sh:message "A displacement quantity must have exactly one decimal numeric value." ;
    ] ;
    sh:property [
        a sh:PropertyShape ;
        sh:path qudt:unit ;
        sh:minCount 1 ;
        sh:maxCount 1 ;
        sh:hasValue unit:KiloTON_Metric ;
        sh:severity sh:Violation ;
        sh:message "A displacement quantity must use exactly the metric kilotonne unit http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/KiloTON_Metric." ;
    ] ;
    rdfs:label "I2-004 displacement quantity value shape"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "Quantity serialization uses qudt:numericValue with xsd:decimal and qudt:unit with an IRI, as declared by the locked JSON-LD representation context."@en .
<END_SHACL>
